_purpose: Ratchet baselines for the donor audits. Each number is the highest problem count that was true and recorded at the stated date. A run that produces MORE problems than this baseline fails; producing fewer requires lowering the baseline in the same change, so donor drift cannot be re-introduced silently.
donor_gate_note: eng/check-donor-sources.py --local-only on 2026-10-31: 0 issues across 37 bindings. The previous note recorded 17 issues across 36 bindings, all of them 'no app-local source tree' for declared but never-vendored donors. That class is now resolved in two honest ways, not by deleting rows: (a) the seven Stage A UI donors (LibreOffice x3, Code - OSS, Thunderbird, Gitea, AppFlowy) are materialised as extracted snapshots at exact upstream revisions, pinned per consuming app with a content digest and file count, with licence notices read from the tree and app-local provenance records; (b) the remaining ones carry an explicit owner-scope status (out-of-scope-for-2026-11-delivery, provisional-scope-not-yet-vendored, superseded-designation-2026-10-31) with a reason and a requirement reference, and are reported separately as 22 named aspirational/deferred rows. llama.cpp is verified as a dependency-lock pinned build, and the audit caught that the registry had recorded a revision nothing builds from: the consumed pin is 3cf03257f219, the newer declared 53ed051ce5e8 upgrade is NOT RUN. Recursive-checkout acceptance is still withheld: the gate now names 7 snapshot donors with no gitlink instead of claiming a PASS that implies one.
census_note: census violations 0, findings 6, measured 2026-10-31 at source 04a19137+ working tree. Findings are the four outstanding Rnote/Canvas consumption gaps (fork branch 44ff1089 not consumed; two patches unapplied at pin 8cac558fa73e; 53981d09b0cd not an ancestor of the pin) plus two provenance gaps for loose vendored trees without a gitlink (Avalonia fork, WinUI Files). None of these was absorbed: the counts are identical to the previous baseline and each remains an open work item.
coverage_note: 28 specification designations, 32 distinct designated donors, 32 registry bindings, 9 coverage problems, measured 2026-10-31. Unchanged from the previous baseline: the new whole-application AppFlowy binding (owner decision 2026-10-31, fork the whole app rather than only the board widget package) maps to the existing specification designation at line 9383 through SYNONYMS, and the designation wording is still re-checked there by test_donor_coverage, so mapping a key is not the same as waiving the wording.
coverage_note_history: 26 -> 24 problems: Avalonia declared as a framework-scope donor with a blob-level fork-equivalence receipt (3,027/3,027 identical), resolving its two designations. 24 -> 9 problems: the 12 designated donors the registry never mentioned are now declared as explicitly aspirational (no source, no pin, licence state recorded as measured or UNVERIFIED), and two legitimate non-submodule verification modes were recorded (files: imported source verified by tree hashes; llama-cpp: pinned prebuilt binary). Nothing was vendored, pinned or integrated to obtain this drop - the count fell because the specification's designations are now declared in the registry, which is what the audit checks. The aspirational class is recorded as 14 audit notes and 12 gate notes naming the outstanding work, so the debt stays visible at the row level rather than only in a total.
